spans.s: 1. चिन्वत्, अन्, अती, अत्, gathering, collecting.
2. चिन्वत्, अन्, अती, अत्, seeking for, searching for.
चिन्वत् चिन्वत्. See p. 322, col. 2.

चिन्त् चिन्त्, cl. 10. P. चिन्तयति, -यितुम्,
(according to some also cl. 1. P. चिन्तति,
&c.), to think, have a thought or idea, reflect, con-
sider; to think about, reflect upon, direct the
thoughts towards any person or thing (with acc.
or dat. or loc., or प्रति with acc., e. g. अन्योन्यं
चिन्तयतस्, they think of one another; सुतेभ्यस्
or सुतेषु or सुतान् प्रति चिन्तयन्, thinking
about one's sons); to mind, take notice of, regard,
turn the attention to; to find out, investigate; to
take into consideration, treat of, speak of; to have
an opinion about, consider as, esteem; [cf. Goth.
thagkja, ‘to think;’ Lat. censeo?].
चिन्त, अस्, m. (?) thought; [cf. चिन्ता.]

चिन्ता, f. thought, especially sad or sorrowful
thought, care, anxiety; reflecting on, reflection, con-
sideration, attention; recollection; N. of a woman.
—चिन्ता-कर्मन्, अ, n. anxiety, troubled thoughts.
—चिन्ता-कारिन्, ई, इणी, इ, considering, regarding.
—चिन्ताकुल (˚ता-आक्˚), अस्, आ, अम्, disturbed in thought,
distracted by any idea.
—चिन्ता-पर, अस्, आ, अम्, lost
in thought, thoughtful, anxious.
—चिन्ता-मणि, इस्,
m. a fabulous gem, supposed to yield its possessor all
desires; the philosopher's stone; a common title of
various text-books, treatises, and commentaries (e. g.
अभिधान-चिन्तामणि, उपमान-च्˚, कृत्य-च्˚,
जन्म-च्˚, मुहूर्त-च्˚); N. of Brahmā; N. of a
Buddha; of an author.
—चिन्तामणि-सारणिका or
तिथि-सारणिका, f. title of a work on astrology by Daśa-
bala.
—चिन्ता-मय, अस्, ई, अम्, consisting of thought
or intelligence, produced by thoughts.
—चिन्ता-वत्,
आन्, अती, अत्, thinking, thoughtful.
—चिन्ता-वेश्मन्,
अ, n. a council-house, council-room.

चिन्तक, अस्, आ, अम्, thinking of, reflecting on,
considering, studying, conversant, familiar with;
(used at the end of compounds, e. g. दैव-चिन्तक,
an astrologer; वंश-चिन्तक, a genealogist &c.)

चिन्तन, अम्, n. thinking, thinking of, reflecting
upon, anxious thought; (पूर्व-चिन्तन, the former
manner of thinking.)

चिन्तनीय, अस्, आ, अम्, to be thought of or con-
sidered; to be meditated on; to be attended to; to
be investigated or comprehended.
चिन्तयत्, अन्, अन्ती, अत्, reflecting, considering, &c.

चिन्तयान, अस्, आ, अम्, reflecting, considering,
meditating.

चिन्तयितव्य, अस्, आ, अम्, to be considered, to be
reflected on.

चिन्तयित्वा, ind. having thought or considered;
having mused or reflected.

चिन्तित, अस्, आ, अम्, thought, considered; reflect-
ing, considering; (आ), f., N. of a woman; (अम्), n.
thought, reflection, care, intention.

चिन्तिति, इस्, f. or चिन्तिया, f. thinking, consideration,
reflection.

चिन्त्य, अस्, आ, अम्, to be considered or reflected;
to be thought of or meditated upon; to be appre-
hended or conceived; to be deliberated about; un-
certain, questionable; (अम्), n. the necessity of
thinking about anything.
—चिन्त्य-द्योत, आस्, m.
pl. a class of deities (whose brightness is only to be
apprehended by the imagination).
चिन्ति चिन्ति, इस्, m., N. of a man (?).

चिन्तिडी चिन्तिडी, f. the tamarind tree; (a
wrong form for तिन्तिडी.)

चिन्तोक्ति चिन्तोक्ति, इस्, f. midnight cry or
alarm; (a wrong form for चित्रोक्ति.)

चिन्न चिन्न, अस्, m. a kind of grain, Pani-
cum Miliaceum; [cf. चीन.]

चीन चीन, आस्, m. pl., N. of a people, the
inhabitants of China, the Chinese; (अस्), m. a kind
of deer; Panicum Miliaceum; a sort of cloth; a
thread; (अम्), n. a banner (perhaps made of deer
skin), a standard; a kind of bandage for the corners
of the eyes; lead.
—चीन-कर्पूर, अस्, m. a kind
of camphor, also called तुषार, द्वीप-कर्पूरज.
—चीन-ज, अम्, n. steel.
—चीन-नी, ईस्, m. a peach
tree.
—चीन-पट्ट, अम्, n. lead.
—चीन-पति, इस्,
m., N. of a kingdom.
—चीन-पिष्ट, अम्, n.
minium or red lead; lead.
—चीनपिष्ट-मय, अस्,
ई, अम्, consisting of minium or representing it.
—चीन-राज-पुत्र, अस्, m. a pear tree.
—चीन-
वङ्ग, अम्, n. lead or more probably tutenag.
—चीनांशुक (˚न-अं˚), अम्, n. China cloth, silk,
a silken cloth.
चिन्मय चिन्मय. See 5. चित्, p. 323.

चीनाकर्कटी चीनाकर्कटी, f. a kind of cu-
cumber said to be found near Citra-kūṭa.
